'''Charred vampire shoe''' is a quest item from the [[Game of Crone]] DLC. It is obtained from the [[Misty Quagmire]], where it can be dug up out of the second mound of dirt after the [[Bone leg]]. Using three [[memory tincture]]s with the shoe will unlock a memory of the past.

After this, it has no further use.
